verdict.rationale: Stripe documents the full pattern: the server creates a session and returns a client_secret, and the client calls collectFinancialConnectionsAccounts to launch a Stripe-hosted authentication flow (docs-6). That flow includes institution selection across 12,000+ banks (docs-7) and removes the need for a custom bank collection form (docs-29), with an account-linked webhook (docs-12) and test institutions (docs-15); a beta integrator moving from Plaid corroborates real-world use (comm-6). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the account/token object returned to the client after linking, and independent hands-on detail on the drop-in flow itself.
